change.title: Extract the behavior-preserving ScienceHostAdapter facade
change.summary: Adds the bounded S4 ScienceHostAdapter facade. Typed launch specs, environment exposure, script acceptance, health, listener identity, managed receipt publication, and the existing typed stop outcome now define the Rust plus shell host boundary. One-click and DB recovery retain their existing authority revalidation, SSH observation, AppState publication, DB reverify, compensation, DTO, text, and operation ordering.

basis: the source boundary proves one-click and DB recovery delegate shell command, exit code, health, listener identity, and managed receipt handling to typed ScienceHostAdapter phases
the transaction source contract preserves the one-click snapshot, checkpoint, compensation, and coordinator ordering while delegating shell wait and health timing

focused Rust transaction, cold-start, receipt-failure compensation, deterministic spawn-failure compensation and retry, post-spawn cleanup, cargo check, and Python boundary tests pass in their required isolated environments

the adapter preserves the existing launch script allowlist, Rust plus shell fail-closed identity checks, post-launch SSH observation, AppState publication timing, visible failure text, and typed Science stop outcome

S5 authority capture, restore, and cleanup extraction, PriorStopIntent or Outcome, Gateway or Skill changes, host-neutral extension, artifact, installed, live, signing, and release validation are excluded
